# `aitbc config import-config`

Import a configuration file into the local or global config.

## Usage

```bash
aitbc config import-config [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--file-path` | text | — | yes | Path to the file. |
| `--merge` | flag | `false` | no | Merge with existing config |
| `--global` | flag | `false` | no | Import to global config |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc config import-config --file-path <file_path>
```
